goal: Prevent corrupted or desynced chainstate and block metadata
when flushing block or undo data to disk fails
reviewability: Small focused patch with dedicated unit test coverage
agreement: Strong support with tested ACK for preventing out-of-sync disk state (optout21)
Concept ACKs agreeing on the corruption risk with separate block storage (mzumsande, arejula27)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it fixes chainstate and block-tree state corruption during block file flush failures
Crucial when block storage fails independently, preventing false marks of durable block data

result.summary: Stops Chainstate::FlushStateToDisk from continuing to write block-index metadata and coins data when FlushChainstateBlockFile fails. Returns the flush error immediately, ensuring m_last_flushed_block remains at the last durable block tip and avoids recording data that failed to persist.
result.problem: When writing block or undo data fails during a flush, FlushStateToDisk currently logs a warning but proceeds to flush block-index and coins database records. If the failure is permanent (such as with a separate -blocksdir), the database marks blocks as stored (BLOCK_HAVE_DATA) even though block or undo files are missing or incomplete.

resolved_concerns: optout21 asked why LogWarning was removed; l0rinc clarified that the lower-level flushError call already reports the failure, avoiding duplicated log entries.
optout21 asked whether skipping the update to m_next_write was intentional; l0rinc clarified the timer update belongs after a successful write and shutdown is already triggered.
maflcko noted a formatting preference regarding combined boolean checks in BOOST_REQUIRE; author and reviewer discussed test grouping conventions.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Modifies Chainstate::FlushStateToDisk in src/validation.cpp and adds a flush failure test in src/test/chainstate_write_tests.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents chainstate and block-tree state desynchronization under disk I/O errors. As mzumsande noted, if block storage fsync fails while coins and index writes succeed, BLOCK_HAVE_DATA could be permanently recorded without underlying block data being durable.

categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Touches src/validation.cpp but only affects chainstate disk flush error handling, not transaction validation, acceptance policy, or mempool limits.

result.card: This PR aborts Chainstate::FlushStateToDisk immediately if FlushChainstateBlockFile fails, returning the error before writing block-index metadata or coins data and before advancing m_last_flushed_block. It resolves a long-standing TODO from #27866 and prevents chainstate and block-tree corruption when block data fails to write (particularly with -blocksdir on separate volumes). Review is in good shape with a tested ACK from optout21 and concept ACKs from mzumsande and arejula27.
